title: Software Engineer
description: Develop industrial monitoring and reporting dashboards using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and Tailwind CSS. Integrate IoT telemetry interfaces, PLC gateways, and maintenance management platforms.
defaultHighlights: Develop industrial monitoring and reporting dashboards using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and Tailwind CSS.
Developed the full Angular Gateway application for communication and control of IoT and PLC devices.
Integrated dashboard interfaces with MQTT-to-ThingsBoard data flows, utilizing Node-RED and REST APIs to retrieve and visualize real-time telemetry.
Worked with ThingsBoard assets, entities, devices, roles and permissions, and called its APIs from custom dashboards.
Contributed to the UI/UX upgrade of the Production Evaluating System (PES) dashboard frontend, redesigning layouts and fixing monitoring issues in collaboration with the team.
Contributed to the Maintenance Management System across UI design, Angular frontend, API integration, and database design.
moreHighlights: Contributed to dashboards for CMMP (Compressor Monitoring), Energy Meter, Flow Meter, Carbon Emission, and Generator Efficiency systems.
Improved UI responsiveness, layout consistency and navigation flow across the CMMP, EMS and FMS platforms.
Designed multi-screen enterprise dashboards for a global consumer-goods client.
Worked on dashboards for the LADWP project; developed dashboards for the Gaugap agritech project.
Researched competitor CMMS platforms (ClickMaint) to guide UX and feature improvements.
Collaborated with iCenter modules to integrate data and enhance dashboard interactions.
Built a custom Markdown editor with rich-text formatting.
Supported operations at a manufacturing client by assessing workflows, improving dashboards and software, and conducting user training.

title: Chip Designer (Trainee)
description: Completed an industrial training program in CMOS circuit design, schematic development, and layout using Cadence Virtuoso and Assura.
defaultHighlights: Completed an industrial training program in CMOS circuit design, schematic development, and layout using Cadence Virtuoso and Assura.
Designed and verified 65nm CMOS circuits (ring oscillator, frequency divider, counter, flip-flop, op-amp), achieving DRC-clean and LVS-clean layouts through systematic debugging and simulation.
Applied timing analysis, parasitic analysis, and signal integrity checks to validate designs against rule-based specifications.
